lede: The county's Board of Review and Planning Commission meet Tuesday to hear about Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code — building standards that could change how construction gets approved around here. Wednesday brings the Livable Telluride kick-off party and a screening of "Forever Wild" celebrating the valley floor protection. The weekend rounds out with the farmers market, Music on the Green, and Telluride Food + Vine.

notable.stake: New building codes could reshape construction approval process countywide
